[Rogue] class gained! — [Stealth]

payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everybody swings wrong at the start. Might as well get it done here. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse. I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are you move and you hit. That's it. That's all the rules.

Hub cursor -> visible row 1, 'You sent a runner for me?'. Row 0 is 'Long shift?', row 2 is 'Just getting my bearings.' -- that is the WHOLE visible list here. dialogue.gd:_visible_options drops progress-gated (accomplishment) requires ENTIRELY rather than rendering them locked, so the unearned 'It's done.' and the chatted_with_zevara>=2 rows are absent, not greyed.

payload_contains.text: There you are. The cisterns crew found something under the new grates: tunnels nobody dug, going down past where their lanterns reached. Olesm's maps say they shouldn't exist. You've been down there. You're going again, this time for the Watch.

steps.name: confirm
steps._comment: summons node row 0 = 'Then I'll go down.' -- THIS is the row that carries the heard_the_deep_tremor effect; the hub row above only walks you to it.

payload_contains.speaker: Zevara
payload_contains.text: Good. See Olesm before you climb down. He's been up since the second bell drawing what shouldn't be there, and he'll want you carrying it. Relc goes with you. I will put him on the roster as your escort and sign it before you are past the gate.

steps._comment: summons_send: row 0 loops to the hub, row 1 ('On it.') ends. Close clean.
